<subject>Railcar R-7248 Derailment Incident on BHP WAGGA Terminal</subject>
<body>
Waiting on response from your team about :  
Meeting with adjuster about pursuing claim against BHP Logistics.  
Engaging technical consultant to challenge the insurer's claims assessor's conclusions.

Have sent letter to rail operator requesting extension for initiating legal action (this safeguards the insurer’s recovery rights).

Seeking clarity on policy requirement to commence "legal proceedings" against insurer within one year of incident. Broker believes this is not mandatory since the claim is lodged and active, but will obtain formal confirmation from insurer/adjuster.

Michael Boyer to contact Perth legal counsel representing BHP Logistics’ insurer about joining their action against rail operator.

If anyone above has additions or corrections to what I’ve outlined, please share now so we’re aligned.
</body>
